sources.title: Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions
sources.scope: territorial, residence/production and footprint/consumption accounting bases

examples.input_condition: A value is labelled territorial, residence/production or footprint/consumption
examples.expected_action: Preserve the accounting basis and never merge the three measures as interchangeable totals
examples.risk_prevented: Comparing emissions with different geographic and economic boundaries

examples.input_condition: A DESNZ table is published by source or on an end-user basis
examples.expected_action: Store allocation_basis separately; do not treat modelled energy reallocation as the physical emitting location
examples.risk_prevented: False facility or parcel attribution

examples.input_condition: The 1990-2024 final release revises earlier years
examples.expected_action: Use one coherent latest-vintage series and retain prior publication lineage
examples.risk_prevented: Mixing historical values from incompatible vintages

examples.input_condition: February source, March end-user and June SIC releases refer to related emissions
examples.expected_action: Keep release_stage and publication_date; do not overwrite one basis with another
examples.risk_prevented: Treating scheduled analytical releases as corrections to the same field

examples.input_condition: An activity record is converted using annual DESNZ factors
examples.expected_action: Require factor_year and reporting_year; reject silent substitution of a different annual factor set
examples.risk_prevented: Untraceable year-on-year conversion drift

examples.input_condition: A calculation uses physical activity data or expenditure multipliers
examples.expected_action: Record method=activity_based or spend_based and do not compare precision as equivalent
examples.risk_prevented: Presenting screening estimates as measured activity emissions

examples.input_condition: A reported result was created with conversion factors
examples.expected_action: Require factor source, version, activity unit and calculation method in provenance
examples.risk_prevented: Opaque CO2e calculations

examples.input_condition: The full factor workbook contains category-specific instructions
examples.expected_action: Apply the relevant worksheet guidance instead of one generic rule across categories
examples.risk_prevented: Wrong boundary, unit or factor selection

examples.input_condition: An emission factor is absent from the NAEI selector
examples.expected_action: Store MISSING_FACTOR_WITH_REASON_UNKNOWN_OR_MODELLED_OR_CONFIDENTIAL; never write zero
examples.risk_prevented: False zero emissions

examples.input_condition: An NAEI emission factor is selected
examples.expected_action: Mark geographic_scope=UK excluding overseas territories and Crown Dependencies unless another source says otherwise
examples.risk_prevented: Applying a UK-specific factor outside its stated scope

examples.input_condition: Factors are available for multiple historical years
examples.expected_action: Match factor year to activity year or document the approved fallback
examples.risk_prevented: Using a current factor for an historical activity without disclosure

examples.input_condition: An estimate equals activity data multiplied by an emission factor
examples.expected_action: Classify as CALCULATED and retain both operands; do not label as directly measured
examples.risk_prevented: Overstating measurement quality

examples.input_condition: Both site-specific and representative-plant factors exist
examples.expected_action: Prefer justified site-specific factors and retain the generic factor only as a cross-check
examples.risk_prevented: Replacing better local evidence with broad averages

examples.input_condition: Permit, BAT or UK ETS rules mandate a release-estimation technique
examples.expected_action: Use the mandatory method before optional generic factors and record the governing requirement
examples.risk_prevented: Non-compliant methodology selection

examples.input_condition: Activity data show a time-series discrepancy or large annual change
examples.expected_action: Flag for investigation before acceptance; do not automatically smooth or copy the prior year
examples.risk_prevented: Hiding real changes or source errors

examples.input_condition: The implied emission factor is an outlier during quality checks
examples.expected_action: Hold the estimate until source data, units and method are reconciled
examples.risk_prevented: Publishing unit or factor errors

examples.input_condition: A method improvement is introduced before annual compilation
examples.expected_action: Expect historical revisions and compare publication vintages before interpreting trends
examples.risk_prevented: Calling a methodological revision a real emissions event

examples.input_condition: An inventory uncertainty interval or Monte Carlo result is available
examples.expected_action: Store statistical uncertainty separately from source-quality confidence percentages
examples.risk_prevented: Conflating model uncertainty with provenance quality

examples.input_condition: Different greenhouse gases are aggregated as CO2 equivalent
examples.expected_action: Require GWP framework/version and gas-specific mass before aggregation
examples.risk_prevented: Incompatible CO2e totals

examples.input_condition: An NAEI factsheet states that its estimates are not aligned with the latest inventory
examples.expected_action: Use it only for historical methodology context and block current numeric promotion
examples.risk_prevented: Publishing outdated emissions as current
